verdicts.ar: في حديثه شيء، يروي أحاديث مناكير أو منكرة
verdicts.en: There is something in his hadith; he transmits some objectionable reports.
They declared him reliable; Ahmad said he transmitted objectionable reports.

flags.label: A reservation on file
flags.detail: Even in the first hadith of the Sahih, one narrator carries a critic's reservation. Ahmad's remark is recorded alongside the general verdict of reliability; Ibn Hajar's summary, “reliable, has reports only he carries”, is the balance. This hadith is one of those reports.

bio: A Madinan Successor of the Taym clan of Quraysh, of the middle generation of Successors.
